affected_component: product_jobs._self_check_round fresh-input agreement probe (propose_workspace_fixture_candidates offline=False, n=1, before the drafted generation) + fresh-audit proposal failure carrying the judge's diagnostics
invariant: Before a draft can pass its self-check, the producer and the independent judge must agree on one input neither was drafted against: each round first proposes one fresh scenario through the same online proposal/materialisation path the post-freeze fresh audit uses (drafter proposal → frozen-to-be builder → reference → verifier → controls); a disagreement fails the round with the judge's reason codes and details and enters the ordinary verifier→verifier→reference repair. The probe runs before the drafted generation so the drafted blueprints remain the latest confirmable generation; without an online drafter the probe is skipped. The fresh audit's proposal failure now carries the judge's diagnostics in reason_codes instead of a bare code.
